highlights: Built a bank-integrated payment processing system in Java and Spring Boot using ICICI Bank APIs for OTP, payment execution, status inquiry and transaction tracking. Pending payments go to a queue for automated reconciliation and eligible failures to a retry queue, cutting manual effort by 60%.

Developed the Event Subscription Tool (EST), an event-driven layer that connects business events to Camunda workflow steps. It supports subscription configuration, event filtering, dynamic field mapping, correlation and idempotent duplicate-event handling.
Migrated the messaging layer from RabbitMQ to Kafka, using a publish-subscribe model with topics and consumer groups.

Automated EST subscription versioning by parsing Camunda BPMN metadata after each deployment, validating process-variable mappings and recovering defective event steps. This reduced manual intervention by 90%.
Built Camunda BPMN workflows for an HRMS platform (onboarding, offboarding, appraisal and employee lifecycle), orchestrating 6+ business processes.

Created a RAG-based knowledge assistant proof of concept with Spring Boot, Spring AI, Qdrant and Ollama, offering semantic search, LLM answers and session-based chat memory over company policies and handbooks.

Led full stack development of an enterprise timesheet and status reporting platform in Node.js, React and PostgreSQL, with rich-text updates and task lifecycle management. Debounced auto-save reduced redundant backend traffic by 35%.
Built payment and monetisation features that increased revenue by 18% and improved transaction success rates by 20%.
Added SEO-optimised doctor profiles with dynamic routing and structured metadata (React Helmet and Google Schema), lifting organic search visibility by 18%.
Developed a subscription management system with Razorpay, improving user retention by 20% and reducing payment processing errors by 11%.
Led development of a real-time patient care system with appointment booking and rescheduling, using test-driven development to keep it reliable.
Worked with the team to ship a Help and Support ticketing system in React and Material UI, which contributed to a 30% increase in customer satisfaction.
Delivered in Agile sprints on a SaaS healthcare product.
